import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    product = 1
    marked = [0] * p
    begin = 1 if k == 1 else 0
    
    for idx in range(begin, p):
        if marked[idx]:
            continue
        node = idx
        while True:
            marked[node] = 1
            node = int((node * k) % p)
            if node == idx or node == 0:
                break
        product = (product * p) % 1000000007
    
    print(product)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
